name: Cerebra — Intelligent Model Router
description: Zero-config intelligent model routing for all agents. Automatically routes each task to the optimal model tier (simple/standard/heavy) based on prompt complexity and your connected providers. Works with any runtime: OpenCode, OpenClaw, Claude, Kimi, Grok, Ollama, or any custom provider.

hooks.name: Cerebra Model Router
hooks.description: Intercepts task.started events and dynamically selects the optimal model based on prompt complexity and connected providers.
